Class ClojureSupport

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker.ClojureSupport
public final class ClojureSupport extends Object
The Clojure runtime calls Juno lowers, from the AOT-compiled code of a direct-linked namespace. A namespace's <clinit> interns each var with literal arguments, the gen-class main reads the var and applies it through IFn. Juno models a var as a handle to its function (the function's index in the program's Clojure functions, or 0 when unbound), so those reads are plain words and IFn.applyTo is a direct call to the one bound function.

Any other clojure.* call is rejected at link time, naming the method that is not yet supported.

    • acceptsDeftypeConstructor

      public static boolean acceptsDeftypeConstructor(JavaClass owner, JavaMethod method, Set<String> referenceClassNames)
      Whether method is a deftype constructor whose parameters exactly mirror its instance fields. Clojure erases reference fields and their constructor parameters to Object; the exact positional match confines that erasure to storage owned by the final generated type instead of admitting Object in arbitrary program methods.

    • constantStaticField

      public static OptionalLong constantStaticField(JavaClass owner, String name, BytecodeDecoder decoder)
      The value of a static final Object field a Clojure class sets in its static initializer to a boxed long literal (ldc2_w; Long.valueOf; putstatic), or empty when it is set to anything else. Clojure keeps a literal constant this way, so reading it yields the literal: the size of (int-array 5), for example. Only an int-range literal is returned, since a boxed value is one word.

    • isClojureObjectField

      The function a namespace's Var.internPrivate at index binds: its invokeStatic(ISeq) in the class the two literal arguments name. Empty when the interned name is not a function (such as equals on a gen-class), or when the arguments are not literals.

    • validateClassLiteral

      public static void validateClassLiteral(LinkedMethod linked, Instruction instruction)
      Juno has no Class objects, so a class literal is admitted only in a namespace's loader, which interns vars and hands the literal to Util.loadWithClass. Anywhere else it fails the link.
